event.description:
Event ticket purchase on gamersguildaz.com is required to participate. Please purchase a ticket to reserve your spot! 

Some of the Entry Prize is only available to the first 60 players who purchase a ticket! Get your ticket early to guarantee the max Entry Prize. 

Purchase your ticket here: https://gamersguildaz.com/products/nphx-7-25-10-30am-grand-archive-rdo-regionals

Outside Food and Drinks are not allowed at the venue! The venue has a restaurant attached if you need any food and drinks. 

Waitlisted Events:
• If you’re not physically present within 5 minutes of the posted start time, your seat may be given to someone on the waitlist, even if you called ahead.
• Game 1 OR Round 1 losses will still apply if you are late and still allowed to participate (at the sole discretion of the TO's and may vary from game to game)
• If your seat is given away, you’ll receive a full refund within 3 business days, and are NOT eligibile for any promos or giveaways.
• Anyone on the waitlist must pay before sitting down, no exceptions—even if things are moving fast.

Format - Constructed, Best of Three
Date - 7/25/26
Location - 1818 W Bell Rd Suite 115, Phoenix, AZ 85023
Registration Time - 10:00am
Start Time - 10:30am

Entry Fee - $35
Prize Payout - 
1st: 1x RDO Season Regional Champion Playmat featuring the art of Shared Fervor

Top 8: 
1x Nationals Qualifier card with a new art of Infinite Scintillation, featuring Merlin
1x RDO Season Regional Finalist Playmat featuring the art of Cleansing Reunion

Entry Prize: 
3x Grand Archive Radiant Origins Booster Pack
1x Radiant Origins Event Pack
1x box of Dragon Shield sleeves (sleeves come in blind boxes where you can obtain one of four art variants) (Only available to the first 60 who purchase a ticket on gamersguildaz.com)
1x Radiant Origins Sapphire Pack (Only available to the first 60 who purchase a ticket on gamersguildaz.com)
1x Proxia’s Vault Pack (Only available to the first 60 who purchase a ticket on gamersguildaz.com)

Additional Prizing in based on attendance:
24 players:
1st: 1x Radiant Origins Box
2nd: 1x Radiant Origins Box
3rd-4th: 12x Radiant Origins packs
5th-8th: 6x Radiant Origins packs

32 players:
1st: 1x Radiant Origins Box + 12x Radiant Origins packs
2nd: 1x Radiant Origins Box + 6x Radiant Origins packs
3rd-4th: 18x Radiant Origins packs
5th-8th: 8x Radiant Origins packs

40 players:
1st: 2x Radiant Origins Box
2nd: 1x Radiant Origins Box + 12x Radiant Origins packs
3rd-4th: 20x Radiant Origins packs
5th-8th: 10x Radiant Origins packs

48 players:
1st: 2x Radiant Origins Box + 6x Radiant Origins packs
2nd: 1x Radiant Origins Box + 18x Radiant Origins packs
3rd-4th: 1x Radiant Origins Box
5th-8th: 14x Radiant Origins packs

56 players:
1st: 2x Radiant Origins Box + 12x Radiant Origins packs
2nd: 2x Radiant Origins Box
3rd-4th: 1x Radiant Origins Box + 6 packs
5th-8th: 18x Radiant Origins packs

64 players:
1st: 3x Radiant Origins Box
2nd: 2x Radiant Origins Box + 6 packs
3rd-4th: 1x Radiant Origins Box + 8 packs
5th-8th: 20x Radiant Origins packs

Max Player Count - 80
Number of Rounds - up to 6
4-8 players: 3 rounds
9-16 players: 4 rounds
17-32 players: 5 rounds
33-64 players: 6 rounds
65-128 players: 7 rounds
Time Per Round - 60 minutes (with 5 minutes overtime)
Contact Point - nphx.events@gamersguildusa.com 

Description - Grand Archive Regionals are Swiss style tournaments which award the top placing players Nationals Qualifier Cards in addition to other prizes. These cards will be worth 3 Nationals Qualifier Points toward the 2027 Nationals events. Players may win multiple duplicate prize cards, but only the first unique copy is redeemable for points at Nationals.

Deck list submission through Omnidex is required. 
Players can submit their decklists online through Omnidex once they have RSVP’d to the event.
We may remove or penalize any players that have not submitted a list on time, in order to ensure the event can continue to run smoothly.

45 minute Lunch Break after Round 3. 

Estimated Schedule:
10:00am - 10:30am: Registration/Check-in
10:30am - 11:35am: Round 1
11:35am - 12:40pm: Round 2
12:40pm - 1:45pm: Round 3
1:45pm - 2:30pm: Lunch (45 minutes)
2:30pm - 3:35pm: Round 4
3:35pm - 4:40pm: Round 5
4:40pm - 5:45pm: Round 6
5:45pm - 6:50pm: Round 7

Ticket on website - https://gamersguildaz.com/products/nphx-7-25-10-30am-grand-archive-rdo-regionals
